_comment: USD per MILLION tokens, by model-id prefix (longest prefix wins). Used by lib.mjs priceUsage() to estimate spend for NATIVE Anthropic calls only — OpenRouter-routed calls return their exact cost in usage.cost and never touch this table. Anthropic cache pricing derives from the input rate: cache READ = 0.1x in, cache WRITE (5m) = 1.25x in. Prices drift — verify against the provider invoice when the dashboard's LLM Spend panel disagrees with the bill, and update here (data-only diff). Jev (TypeSafe) is priced from this table too: $0.042/Mtok input, output free — jev.mjs meters every call. 2026-11-10: added Fable 5.2, Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5 (both spellings, because prefix match would otherwise price claude-opus-5-5 as Opus 5 and claude-opus-4-8 as the old $15/$75 Opus 4) and Opus 4.6-4.8 at $5/$25; `cacheRead` overrides the 0.1x read rate where the model prices it lower. Haiku 5.5's rate is for prompts up to 100K tokens ($0.50/$2.50 beyond).
